title: Set IBus environment variables
summary: Configure environment variables required for IBus to work correctly with GTK and Qt applications.

steps.explain: Add the following lines to your environment configuration file (e.g., ~/.pam_environment or /etc/environment). For Wayland: GTK_IM_MODULE=wayland, XMODIFIERS=@im=ibus, QT_IM_MODULES=wayland;ibus, QT_IM_MODULE=ibus. For X11: GTK_IM_MODULE=ibus, XMODIFIERS=@im=ibus, QT_IM_MODULE=ibus.

rollback.explain: Remove the added lines from your environment configuration file.

warnings: Editing system-wide files requires root privileges.
Incorrect variables can break input methods.
